steps.output:
def transform(grid):
    k = max(max(row) for row in grid)
    first = grid[0][0]
    out = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        start = first if r == 0 else (first % k) + 1
        rr = []
        for c, x in enumerate(row):
            idx = c - 1 if r > 0 and c >= r else c
            value = (start - 1 + idx) % k + 1
            rr.append(x if x else value)
        out.append(rr)
    return out
